items.title: Works over fullscreen apps
items.text: On a Mac, your Roamie now shows up over fullscreen apps and games instead of hiding.

items.title: Stays out of your games
items.text: In a fullscreen game, I move your Roamie aside and every click goes to the game.

items.title: Talk in your language
items.text: On a Mac, voice input was stuck in English. Now it listens in the language you use.

items.title: Typing works on Linux
items.text: On KDE, the ask box often ignored your typing after you used another app. Fixed that.

items.title: Send an agent
items.text: Say "send an agent to…" and a helper does the job in the background while you work.

items.title: See what agents made
items.text: When an agent's done, its files pop up in the corner. Click one to open it.

items.title: What's new
items.text: This page! After each update I'll show you what changed, right here.

items.title: OpenCode keys
items.text: Got OpenCode Go or OpenCode credits? Add your key on the Model page and use it.

items.title: Better web reading
items.text: I upgraded how Roamies searches the web and reads pages, so answers are cleaner.

items.title: Pin a card
items.text: Click the pin on a card and it stays put until you close it, even when you switch apps.

items.title: Resize cards
items.text: Drag a card's corner to make it bigger or smaller, or blow it up to full screen.

items.title: First click works
items.text: Clicking Allow or the panel while another app was in front did nothing. Now it works.

items.title: Roamie shows up after sleep
items.text: If Roamies started while your screen slept, the Roamie never appeared. Fixed that.

items.title: Follows your screens
items.text: Plug in or unplug a screen and your Roamie moves over to where your screens are now.

items.title: Talk key misfires
items.text: Holding the talk keys was sometimes taken for a shortcut. Talking works reliably now.

items.title: Buttons no longer hidden
items.text: The little task label could cover Allow and Don't allow. It moves out of the way now.

items.title: Commands on Windows
items.text: On Windows, commands with quotes in them failed. They run properly now.

items.title: Tooltips fit the panel again
items.text: I shrank the help popups in the panel so they stop covering everything.

items.title: No more stray Claude processes
items.text: If Roamies crashed, Claude Code kept running in the background. I close it properly now.

items.title: Logs don't grow forever
items.text: The helper logs kept getting bigger. I trim them now so they don't hog your disk.

items.title: Old snaps get cleaned up
items.text: I made Roamies delete the area snaps you send once it's done with them.

items.title: Gemini voices
items.text: I added Google's Gemini voices for your Roamie to talk with. Pick one in Voice.

items.title: VoiceStudio voices
items.text: Got the VoiceStudio app? Roamies can now use its voices, right on your computer.

items.title: Meet Rita X
items.text: I added a new look called Rita X. Try her out in Appearance.

items.title: Windows 11 tray icon stays put
items.text: Windows 11 kept hiding the icon. I pin it next to the clock now.

items.title: Change or remove your keys
items.text: Every account now has Change key and Remove, so you're never stuck with an old key.

items.title: Local models with Ollama
items.text: I added Ollama (beta), so Roamies can run on AI models on your own computer.

items.title: Errors instead of crashes
items.text: When a request failed, Roamies used to crash. Now it just tells you what went wrong.

items.title: Quicker, cheaper replies
items.text: I trimmed Roamies' instructions, so it thinks a bit faster and costs a bit less.

items.title: Repeating reminders
items.text: Ask for a reminder every day, week or month and Roamies keeps it going.

items.title: Typing in Notepad works again
items.text: On Windows 11, typing in Notepad came out scrambled. I fixed it, emoji included.

items.title: Just say "Hey Roamies"
items.text: On a Mac you can now wake your Roamie with your voice. No keys needed.

items.title: Errors in plain English
items.text: I rewrote the error messages so they make sense, with a short code if you need help.

items.title: Type to ask
items.text: Tap ⌥⌘ (Ctrl+Shift on PC) and a text box pops up by your cursor. You can pick the keys.

items.title: Explanations you can see
items.text: Ask how something works and Roamies draws it: flows, tables, charts, maps and maths.

items.title: Quizzes and 3D models
items.text: It can quiz you, label photos and show moving parts in 3D, like an engine.

items.title: Save diagnostics
items.text: Something broken? Hit Save diagnostics in About and send me the file.

items.title: Clearer mic errors
items.text: When the mic isn't working, Roamies now says why and how to fix it.

items.title: A tidier panel
items.text: I split long lists into pages, put updates up top and added a Quit button.

items.title: Roamies on Linux (beta)
items.text: I brought Roamies to Linux, voice and all. It works on X11 and Wayland.

items.title: Watch it work
items.text: Your Roamie now hops along with the cursor while it works in other apps.

items.title: Allow buttons
items.text: Before Roamies does something risky, you get Allow and Don't allow buttons.

items.title: Keep talking, hands-free
items.text: After a reply, Roamies keeps listening for a moment so you can just carry on.

items.title: Esc clears drawings
items.text: Pressing Esc with drawings on screen now does what you'd expect.

items.title: Keys go to the right app
items.text: Keys Roamies presses no longer land in some other app by mistake.

items.title: Window outlines line up
items.text: The frame Roamies draws around a window now sits right on its edges.

items.title: Panel opens at full size
items.text: On Macs with mixed screens the panel opened half size or on the wrong screen. Fixed.

items.title: No more silent stalls
items.text: Sometimes Roamies just went quiet. I found the cause and fixed it.

items.title: Chats survive updates
items.text: Your chats and Get to Know Me answers no longer vanish after an update.

items.title: Typing cursor is back
items.text: The blinking cursor in text boxes was hidden. You can see it again.

items.title: Updates in the panel
items.text: When an update is ready, you'll see it at the top of the panel.

items.title: Windows catches up
items.text: On Windows, Roamies can now click and type for you, snap an area and circle things.

items.title: Saving temp files on Windows
items.text: A safety check wrongly blocked saving temp files on Windows. Fixed.

items.title: Sharper pointing
items.text: Rings now fit what's on screen exactly, and Roamies finds even single letters.

items.title: Marks every match
items.text: Ask where something is and Roamies marks every spot it shows up, not just one.

items.title: Tighter safety checks
items.text: I closed a few gaps where risky commands could slip past the safety checks.

items.title: Bounces back from crashes
items.text: If Roamies' brain crashes, it restarts by itself now.

items.title: Trusted Mac install
items.text: The Mac download is notarized by Apple now, so it opens cleanly. Needs macOS 13.5+.

items.title: Privacy notice
items.text: I wrote down exactly what Roamies does with your data. Short version: I collect nothing.

items.title: Steps said once, not twice
items.text: Guided steps were sometimes read out twice. Now you hear each one once.

items.title: Updates download reliably
items.text: Updates failed when GitHub was slow. I added a backup route so they come through.

items.title: No more reading out code
items.text: After a restart, Roamies sometimes read its own tool calls aloud. Not anymore.

items.title: Web answers in the right spot
items.text: Web answer cards open where the drawn cards go, and don't scroll sideways.

items.title: Drawings clear on new pages
items.text: Drawings stuck around when a page was slow to read. They clear properly now.

items.title: Drawings follow the screen
items.text: When the page changes under a drawing, Roamies wipes it, in any app.

items.title: Replies start sooner
items.text: I cut the wait before Roamies starts talking, and gave each voice more variety.

items.title: Photo cards fit
items.text: Photo cards now size themselves to the picture.

items.title: Stop really stops
items.text: After you hit Stop, leftover tool labels no longer hang around.
